title: What was revenue by country in October, after refunds?
short: What was revenue by country in October, after refunds?
subtitle: try 1

show.label: Query the agent wrote
show.code:
SELECT c.country,
       sum(o.total_cents - coalesce(r.refunded, 0)) / 100.0 AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT order_id, sum(amount_cents) AS refunded
  FROM refunds
  GROUP BY order_id
) r ON r.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.placed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND o.placed_at < '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

title: For each signup month, what share of customers ordered more than once?
short: For each signup month, what share of customers ordered more than once?
subtitle: try 1

show.label: Query the agent wrote
show.code:
SELECT date_trunc('month', c.signed_up_at) AS cohort,
       avg((o.n > 1)::int) AS repeat_rate
FROM customers c
JOIN (
  SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS n
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'paid'
  GROUP BY customer_id
) o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY cohort;

title: Which product category grew the most from September to October?
short: Which product category grew the most from September to October?
subtitle: try 1

show.label: Query the agent wrote
show.code:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT p.category,
         date_trunc('month', o.placed_at) AS month,
         sum(i.quantity * i.price_cents) AS revenue
  FROM order_items i
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
  WHERE o.placed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.placed_at < '2026-11-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT category,
       max(revenue) FILTER (WHERE month = '2026-10-01')
     - max(revenue) FILTER (WHERE month = '2026-09-01') AS growth
FROM monthly
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY growth DESC
LIMIT 1;

GROUP BY category
ORDER BY growth DESC
LIMIT 1;
